item.author: Robert Kirkman, Charlie Adlard
item.description: El enfrentamiento con los cazadores llega a su desenlace. Para garantizar la seguridad del grupo, Rick se plantea medidas que obligan a todos a preguntarse cuánto de su humanidad están dispuestos a sacrificar.

en.description: The confrontation with the hunters reaches its conclusion. To secure the group's safety, Rick considers measures that force everyone to question how much of their humanity they are prepared to sacrifice.
